title: Baluchistan Cancellation of Illegal Allotments of State Land Act 1996

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Cancellation of Illegal Allotments of State Land Act 1996
sections.description:
Short title commencement and extent

ACT V OF 1996
ACT V OF 1996
BALOCHISTAN CANCELLATION OF ILLEGAL ALLOTMENTS OF STATE LAND ACT, 1996
An Act to provide for the cancellation of illegal allotments of State
lands in the Province of Balochistan
1. Short title, extent and
commencement. ‑‑‑(I) This Act may be called the Balochistan
Cancellation of Illegal Allotments of State Land Act, 1996.
(2) It shall extend to the
whole of Balochistan except the Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 13th day of January, 1994.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Cancellation of Illegal Allotments of State Land Act 1996
sections.description:
Definitions

ACT V OF 1996
ACT V OF 1996
BALOCHISTAN CANCELLATION OF ILLEGAL ALLOTMENTS OF STATE LAND ACT, 1996
An Act to provide for the cancellation of illegal allotments of State
lands in the Province of Balochistan
2. Definitions. ‑‑In this Act, unless there is anything
repugnant in the subject or context:‑
(a) "Authority" means
the Member Board of revenue of Balochistan;
(b) "Board of
Revenue" means the Board of Revenue constituted under the Board of Revenue
Act, 1957;
(c) "Government"
means the Government of Balochistan;
(d) "Illegal
allotments" means allotments declared as illegal allotments by and under
this Act;
(e) "Land Lease
Policy" means the policy notified under Notification, No. 940‑8/86‑Rev.,
dated 15th March, 1988, issued by the Govern ,; and
(f) "Revenue Officer"
means and includes the Revenue Officer as classified and defined in the
Balochistan Land Revenue Act, 1967.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Cancellation of Illegal Allotments of State Land Act 1996
sections.description:
Illegal allotment

ACT V OF 1996
ACT V OF 1996
BALOCHISTAN CANCELLATION OF ILLEGAL ALLOTMENTS OF STATE LAND ACT, 1996
An Act to provide for the cancellation of illegal allotments of State
lands in the Province of Balochistan
3. Illegal allotments. ‑‑‑Notwithstanding anything
contained in any other law, rules or instructions for the time being in force,
all allotments of State land made during the period between 15th March, 1988
and 18th August, 1993, both days inclusive, in contravention of the Land Lease
Policy by whatever authority of the Government, including a Revenue Officer,
are hereby declared to be illegal allotments:
Provided that the provision of
this section shall not apply to any allotments made in favour of a Federal or
Provincial Government Department, for a public purpose.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Cancellation of Illegal Allotments of State Land Act 1996
sections.description:
Cancellation of illegal allotments

ACT V OF 1996
ACT V OF 1996
BALOCHISTAN CANCELLATION OF ILLEGAL ALLOTMENTS OF STATE LAND ACT, 1996
An Act to provide for the cancellation of illegal allotments of State
lands in the Province of Balochistan
4. Cancellation of Illegal
allotments. ‑‑‑(I) All illegal allotments shall stand
cancelled forthwith.
(2) In consequence of
cancellation of illegal allotments the Revenue Officer concerned shall correct
the Revenue Record accordingly through its revenue staff in the district; or in
whose custody the Revenue Record is kept and maintained.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Cancellation of Illegal Allotments of State Land Act 1996
sections.description:
Resumption of land

ACT V OF 1996
ACT V OF 1996
BALOCHISTAN CANCELLATION OF ILLEGAL ALLOTMENTS OF STATE LAND ACT, 1996
An Act to provide for the cancellation of illegal allotments of State
lands in the Province of Balochistan
5. Resumption of land.‑‑(1) All State land, whose illegal
allotments stands cancelled under this Act, shall stand resumed in favour of
the State, and the Revenue Officer of the District concerned shall take
possession thereof forthwith;
(2) The Board of Revenue shall
refund the sale proceeds or lease money to the allottees, if and when, claimed
by them.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Cancellation of Illegal Allotments of State Land Act 1996
sections.description:
Eligibility

ACT V OF 1996
ACT V OF 1996
BALOCHISTAN CANCELLATION OF ILLEGAL ALLOTMENTS OF STATE LAND ACT, 1996
An Act to provide for the cancellation of illegal allotments of State
lands in the Province of Balochistan
6. Eligibility.----‑‑Allottee, whose allotment stands
cancelled under this Act, may apply to the Board of Revenue for fresh allotment
in accordance with the Land Lease Policy:
Provided that he fulfils all
the conditions as laid down in the Land Lease Policy, and is eligible
thereunder.

sections.description:
Bar of jurisdiction

ACT V OF 1996
ACT V OF 1996
BALOCHISTAN CANCELLATION OF ILLEGAL ALLOTMENTS OF STATE LAND ACT, 1996
An Act to provide for the cancellation of illegal allotments of State
lands in the Province of Balochistan
7. Bar of Jurisdiction. ‑‑‑(I) Any order passed or
proceeding taken by the Board of Revenue, or any Revenue Officer, under this
Act, shall not be called in question in any Court.
(2) Any proceedings pending in
any Court against Government or the Board of Revenue for claim on account of
illegal allotment of Siate land, shall abate on under this Act and the rules
made thereunder.
